text:
I'd like to share my personal experience to provide information for those considering clear aligner treatment at this clinic.

Initially, I inquired about the price and was quoted around 19,xxx baht. However, on the actual visit, there were additional charges bringing the total to approximately 25,000 baht, significantly different from my initial understanding.

During the consultation, I didn't even see a doctor; I only spoke with staff and nurses. The mouth scanning (performed by the counter staff) and X-rays felt insufficient for a thorough case assessment on the first day.

The clinic stated that treatment could be completed within approximately 4 months, and the teeth would be perfectly aligned. Therefore, I decided to pay on that day. *There was no doctor's assessment on that day. I only met the doctor for the first time about 3 weeks later, on the appointment to receive the aligners.*

On the day the aligners were fitted, there were several issues with the attachments coming loose, handled by the assistant, requiring the doctor to intervene. Furthermore, the number of aligners provided only covered 3 months, which was confusing given the initial timeframe.

The quality of the aligners received was consistently poor. They lacked precision and were cut to a sharp point, causing sores on my tongue and gums.

After completing the treatment, the results were not as expected. My teeth were not properly aligned. Compared to the nearly 30,000 baht cost, I was very disappointed with my overall experience. The communication, care, and appointment system are all quite slow, with very long waiting times each time.

This review is based solely on our personal experience. We recommend researching, comparing multiple clinics, and asking for complete details before making a decision.

The service was excellent and very fast. I arrived on time, filled out the information, and got it done right away. The price wasn't high either. It was my first time there. I got teeth whitening during a promotion for 1,666 baht. They did two sessions, and my teeth whitened by about 14 shades. After whitening, I only experienced slight sensitivity in a few teeth, but it disappeared within a day. My gums were also fine. I also had tartar removed. The whole process took less than an hour and a half. The female dentist was very quick, but she kept my eyes closed the whole time, so it felt like a long time, haha. Luckily, they played music during the whitening process. I'm usually very afraid of dental work, but the dentist was very gentle and kept asking if I was okay and if I felt uncomfortable. She was very friendly and gave good advice. She hardly tried to sell anything, which was very genuine. Don't hesitate, I highly recommend this place. I don't know what the other dentists are like, though. The dentist I went to seemed to be only available on Saturdays and Sundays.

I had a retainer made. I'm not sure how attentive the doctors are at other clinics, but at our clinic, the doctor didn't ask many questions, quickly took impressions, and I received the retainer in about a week. On the day I picked it up, there was no doctor present; only the counter staff handed me the retainer and asked if it fit.

After using it for less than a month, I noticed marks on the retainer. I messaged the clinic to inquire about the material, and the response from the staff was quite shocking. If you're considering getting a retainer here, I personally think it might still be a bit risky.
I was very impressed with the cleanliness and professionalism of the team. Everything seemed well-organized. The doctor gave straightforward advice, and I didn't feel pressured about the cost at all.
The dentist had a very gentle touch during the dental implant procedure. It took a little time, but it was well worth it. I looked at many clinics and finally chose this one. I'm very impressed.

Long wait, dishonest service. The promotion said 29,000 baht, but in reality, they wanted me to do this and that, pushing the price to 60,000 baht or more. They didn't ask for my consent; they made me get an X-ray and I had to pay 1,000 baht without realizing it.
After teeth whitening, my teeth became several shades whiter and I didn't experience any sensitivity.
